title: Medicare Therapy Threshold Amounts for the Insured Plan of Care
content:
**Compliance note — Insured Plan of Care.** The Medicare therapy KX-modifier threshold and the targeted medical review threshold are payer-program values. They are calendar-year allowed amounts for physical therapy and speech-language pathology combined.

| Payer program | KX threshold applies | KX threshold amount (calendar year) | Targeted medical review threshold (calendar year) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Plan of Care | No | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care | No | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Commercial POS Plan of Care | No | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Commercial HMO Plan of Care | No | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Medicare Part B Plan of Care | Yes | $2480.00 | $3000.00 |
| Medicare Advantage Plan of Care | No | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Medicaid Managed Care Plan of Care | No | $0.00 | $0.00 |

**Definitions.**
- *KX threshold applies* — whether the Medicare therapy KX-modifier threshold applies to visits on the plan.
- *KX threshold amount* — the calendar-year allowed amount for physical therapy and speech-language pathology combined above which visits carry the KX modifier; $0.00 where the threshold does not apply.
- *Targeted medical review threshold* — the calendar-year allowed amount above which visits are subject to Medicare targeted medical review; $0.00 where the KX threshold does not apply.

The Medicare Part B Plan of Care is the only payer program to which these thresholds apply; the Medicare Advantage Plan of Care shows $0.00 for both. On the Medicare Part B Plan of Care the review threshold of $3000.00 lies $520.00 above the KX threshold of $2480.00.
